visual_elements.description: MAIN DIAGRAM — multi-head self-attention dataflow for one word (X₂). Top: small segmented output vector labeled Y₁ with dimension tag '1×d'. Arrow down to white red-bordered box 'Linear Transformation [T] dH×d'. Arrow down to pill container labeled 'Concatenated Vector 1×dH' holding 12 cells in 4 color groups: Y¹ (orange, ~3 cells), Y² (dark gray, ~3), Y³ (yellow, ~3), Y⁴ (green, ~3) [cell counts approximate]. Below, five overlapping rounded-rectangle 'head layers' stacked with diagonal offset, back-to-front: h=5 (backmost, largely hidden behind the green-bordered inset panel — its fill color and full extent not clearly visible [?]; its h=5 badge partially occluded by the inset), h=4 (light green), h=3 (light yellow), h=2 (light purple), h=1 (salmon red, front, fully detailed). Each layer carries white pill labels 'Similarity' (all layers), 'Probability'/'Probabilities' (h=2, h=1), 'Weighted SUM' (all layers), and a dark circular badge top-right of the layer reading h=5 (partially occluded by the inset), h=4, h=3, h=2, h=1 (white bold text). Small green-dashed output vectors sit at each layer's top edge feeding the concatenation bar. FRONT LAYER (h=1) internals, left→right: (1) column of four green-dashed input vectors labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (each ~4–5 cells); (2) column of four blue boxes 'W_k^0' with adjacent labels K₁, K₂, K₃, K₄; (3) tan/beige 'Dot Product' box containing a bipartite dot-and-line graph (blue dots connected by thin lines), annotated 'K,q' at its top-right; (4) tall pink box 'Scaling by √d' with 'K,q / √d' written above it; (5) tall pink box 'Soft max'; (6) label 'Probabilities' with a small green arrow; (7) white box with blue 'Σ' and label 'Weighted SUM' above; (8) column of labels V₁, V₂, V₃, V₄ each with a red ⊗ (circled-times) multiply symbol and a blue box 'W_v^0'; (9) column of four green-dashed output vectors on the layer's right edge.
visual_elements.position: center-left, occupying ~70% of slide width and ~65% of height

visual_elements.description: INSET BLOCK DIAGRAM (right side, white panel with thick green border) — canonical transformer attention block: top white box 'Linear' → down arrow → white box 'Concat' → three down arrows into a stack of ~4 overlapping purple boxes labeled 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' (stack conveys h parallel copies; a small arrow and italic 'h' annotate the stack) → three up arrows from three white boxes each labeled 'Linear' → bottom labels 'V', 'K', 'Q' under the three Linear boxes.

DIMENSION LEGEND (bottom-right corner, green dashed border): a small horizontal vector of ~4 yellow cells tagged '1×d', then an orange box 'W', then '=', then a small orange grid tagged 'd×d', then '=' result vector tagged '1×d'. Blue caption below: 'd: Embedding Length'.

Thick dark-red curved arrow starting near the highlighted input X₂ (bottom-left), sweeping right and upward to the per-head weight-matrix grid / stacked layers; red bold label along it reads 'H¹ Heads' [?]. A second short solid red arrow points from below into the pink-highlighted X₂ cell of the bottom-left input box.
3×3 GRID OF WEIGHT MATRICES: nine blue rounded boxes with white text, rows: W_q¹ W_k¹ W_v¹ / W_q² W_k² W_v² / W_q³ W_k³ W_v³ (superscripts 1,2,3 = heads; subscripts q,k,v = projection type).
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with black bold '44' at top-right corner.

imagery: No photographs or illustrations; the slide is entirely composed of vector shapes: rounded layer rectangles, dashed-border vector boxes, colored cell strips, circular badges, arrows, and one green-framed inset panel.
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title bold, ~26–30pt, black, with red 'X₂' subscript. Subtitle bold with blue quoted 'Wide'. All diagram labels small (~9–12pt); layer pill labels and box labels regular weight; badges (h=1..h=4) and '44' bold white/black respectively; 'Dot Product', 'Scaling by √d', 'Soft max' set vertically (rotated 90°) inside tall boxes; 'd: Embedding Length' bold blue; weight-matrix text white on blue. Heavy use of subscripts/superscripts throughout (X₁..X₄, K₁..K₄, V₁..V₄, W_k^0, W_v^0, W_q^1..3).
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — all four head layers, labels, inset panel, legend, and arrows are visible simultaneously; no mid-build reveal detected.
recreation_brief: Set slide background to light gray #E6E6E6 and add a dark-red (#990000) rectangle frame ~8–10 pt thick around the entire slide edge.

Top-right: add title text 'Multi Head Self Attention of Word X₂' in bold black Arial ~28 pt, right-of-center (x≈50–90%); color the 'X₂' red (#CC0000) with subscript 2. Place a yellow (#FFD700) circle (~0.9 cm) at the very top-right corner containing bold black '44'.

Directly under the title add subtitle '"Wide" Architecture' — bold, with 'Wide' in blue (#0000CC) inside quotation marks. Draw the FULL text: in the original frame the green-bordered inset panel is drawn ON TOP and occludes the subtitle's right tail (visible glyphs read '"Wide" Architec...') — reproduce that occlusion by layering the inset over the subtitle rather than truncating the text.
Top-center: draw a small horizontal vector of ~5 cells (one cell yellow-highlighted, labeled Y₁) with tag '1×d' beside it.
Below it: white rectangle with red border containing text 'Linear Transformation   [ T ]  dH×d' (bold, ~14 pt).

Below that: a full-width rounded pill (white fill, thin border). Left-inside label two lines: 'Concatenated Vector' / '1×dH'. Inside the pill draw 12 cells in 4 color groups of 3: orange (#E8A33D) cells labeled Y¹, dark-gray (#595959) cells labeled Y², yellow (#E8D44D) cells labeled Y³, green (#8FCE8F) cells labeled Y⁴.

Draw five rounded rectangles stacked with a diagonal offset (each ~15% smaller and shifted up-right going back): backmost = h=5 (largely hidden behind the inset panel — draw it BEFORE the inset so the inset occludes its right portion and its h=5 badge, as in the original frame; fill color not clearly visible in the analysis — by the slide-45 family pattern likely cream #F2EAD3, verify against the frame at build time), then light green #C8E6C0 ('h=4'), light yellow #EDEDA8 ('h=3'), light purple #C9A0DC ('h=2'), front salmon #F08080 ('h=1'). Badges: dark circles (matching darker shade of each layer) with bold white text, placed at each layer's top-right; the h=5 badge is partially covered by the inset panel (real frame content — reproduce the occlusion).

On layers h=2–h=4 add small white pill labels 'Similarity' and 'Weighted SUM' (add 'Probability' on h=2); add a few small green-dashed output-vector boxes at each layer's top edge with thin red connector arrows up to the concatenation pill.

Build the front (h=1) layer pipeline left→right: (a) four green-dashed vector boxes labeled X₁–X₄; (b) four blue (#4472C4) boxes 'W_k^0' with white text, labeled K₁–K₄; (c) tan (#EAD9B0) box 'Dot Product' containing ~6 blue dots joined by thin lines (bipartite graph), tag 'K,q'; (d) tall pink (#E79FE0) box with rotated text 'Scaling by √d' and 'K,q / √d' above it; (e) tall pink box with rotated 'Soft max'; (f) label 'Probabilities' with a small green arrow; (g) white box with large blue 'Σ', label 'Weighted SUM' above; (h) four rows each with label V₁/V₂/V₃/V₄, a red ⊗ symbol, and a blue box 'W_v^0'; (i) four green-dashed output vectors at the right edge. Connect all stages with thin red arrows left→right.

Right side: draw a white panel with thick green (#00AA00) border (x≈77–96%, y≈15–55%). Inside, top-to-bottom: white box 'Linear' → arrow → white box 'Concat' → three arrows → stack of 4 overlapping purple (#B399D5) boxes labeled 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' with small italic 'h' + arrow annotation → three arrows up from three white boxes each labeled 'Linear' → bottom labels 'V', 'K', 'Q'.
Bottom-center-right: create a 3×3 grid of blue (#4472C4) rounded boxes with white bold text: row1 W_q¹ W_k¹ W_v¹; row2 W_q² W_k² W_v²; row3 W_q³ W_k³ W_v³.

Draw a thick dark-red (#990000) curved arrow (block arc or curved connector, ~8 pt) from the bottom-left input area sweeping right and up to the weight-matrix grid; add red bold label 'H¹ Heads' along the curve.

Bottom-right corner: green dashed-border legend containing a small 4-cell yellow vector tagged '1×d', an orange (#FFA500) box 'W', '=', a small orange 4×4-ish grid tagged 'd×d', '=' and a result vector tagged '1×d'; below the box add blue bold caption 'd: Embedding Length'.
Bottom-left: green dashed-border box containing four small vectors labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ — fill X₂'s cells pink (#FF9ECF) to highlight it; add a short solid red arrow pointing up into X₂ from below.
